source: GoatCounter aggregates via the existing site pipeline (path prefix /zfrontier/multi-vrf-firewall-insertion). This stub is filled at view time from /data/visitors.json when local page rows are empty.
metric: GoatCounter visitor count: each visitor counted once per page per day.
countries_note: Prefix-specific country totals are not collected until the visitor-stats workflow has a path-filtered locations result for this prefix. Site-wide country totals stay on /visitors/countries/ and are not shown here as visits to this page.
isps_note: Prefix-specific ISP totals are not collected. Existing ISP events are site-wide GoatCounter isp/* events and are not tagged with this page path. Visitor IPs are never stored, so a masked-IP column cannot be filled.
per_visit_note: Per-visit rows (time, page, country, ISP, masked IP) are not collected. The existing pipeline publishes aggregates only, and never stores visitor IPs. GoatCounter Individual pageviews is off, and even if it were enabled it would not include IP addresses.
note: GoatCounter recording was already on these pages in v1. Counts appear here once the hourly visitor-stats snapshot includes this path prefix. Past visits before that snapshot cannot be backfilled.
